title: Kind of Pale
text: Kind of Pale. Most of the flowers I got are really crinkled up from being stuffed in the packaging. The colors are also not as vibrant as the picture. These are double layered, so they don't lay very flat, and they have a place on the bottom that you could insert a stem if you wanted to. Some of the centers of the flowers are a really ugly color. ,I was hoping to use these in a fairly flat application, but will have to rethink.
